profile.name: Rishabh Chandrode
profile.headline: I build reliable web systems — from database queries to the pixels on screen.
profile.summary: Software engineer at Internshala working across the stack: internal tooling, performance work, and user-facing product. I care about clean code, smart systems, and stuff that just works.
about: Hi, I'm Rishabh. I write code, break things (sometimes on purpose), fix them, and repeat — until it all just clicks.

I love building software that feels smooth, solves real problems, and maybe even makes someone's day a little easier. Whether it's frontend, backend, cloud, or gluing APIs together — I'm in. I don't chase trends, I chase clarity.
Outside the code cave you'll catch me strumming my guitar, digging into underrated music, or testing my patience in the name of "fun" (thanks, Sekiro).

points: Automated workflows with cron jobs, enhanced internal tools, and built UIs for marketing campaigns, increasing user engagement by 25%.
Refactored complex SQL queries and migrated operations to NoSQL with multi-threading, improving database performance by 30%.
Optimized the codebase for SEO, cutting page load time by 35%, hardened API validations, and resolved 20+ critical issues.
Built a customizable chatbot platform with Python Flask and Jinja, cutting chatbot setup time by 50% compared to traditional methods.
Integrated OpenAI's GPT-3.5 for natural language processing, reaching an 85% user satisfaction rating on responses.
Deployed and debugged the application on AWS, ensuring scalability and reliable performance.
